THE SCENE

You are the director of a short film for drama class. You will film one scene as a shadow play. The actors stand behind a big white sheet. A boy walks home alone at night. First he feels calm. Then he hears a sound and feels worried. A giant shadow scares him. Then he sees it is his grandfather, and he feels safe. You need four choices to show how he feels. Four people can each help you.

THE HISTORY

Your film uses an idea from Ibn Daniyal of Cairo. About 700 years ago, he wrote shadow plays. Small figures moved behind a white sheet. A lamp made their shadows on the sheet. His plays are some of the oldest plays in Arabic.
